extracted.name: Fried PorkLoin
extracted.description: A super simple delicious recipe. The only thing that I like to eat more than fried pork and ketchup for a meal is fried chicken and ketchup.
instruction_lines: Rinse, season, and bread the porkloin.
Move to a paper towel to absorb excessive amounts of oil. Serve, I hope you enjoy!!!
